items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: And so Bunk played that night, and George Brunus was there, and Paul Morales, and we had Brother McGrummers on the piano, and Lee Collins, he used Lee Collins on.

ctx.x: The horn might be on another train.

See they rediscovered him from New Ile Berry. He was in New Ile Berry, they were working. And so Bunk played that night, and George Brunus was there, and Paul Morales, and we had Brother McGrummers on the piano, and Lee Collins, he used Lee Collins on. We had Darnell Howard, and somebody else.
What did you think about Bunk playing then?

items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: And getting back to, well Lee played with Joe Oliver at the Lincoln Garden too, see?

ctx.x: fights, he was the instructor back there.

Yeah, well he was a regular fashion player. Twenty-five or thirty suits of clothes. They'd give him suits of clothes just to advertise. I heard he died not so long ago in New York. And getting back to, well Lee played with Joe Oliver at the Lincoln Garden too, see? Well now the Sidewalk Blues, Lee wrote the Sidewalk Blues and Jellie Roten, turned it over to Jellie Roten and Jellie Roten had it to copyright it. And that was the last, that was the last, maybe Lee told you about it.
But Lee never did talk about it?

items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: Preston Jackson and then a little drum roll player, what's his name again? Al Wynn. Since I've been sick I can't think of nobody's name. Al Wynn, they put me over there in Lincoln Garden.

ctx.x: Yeah, and where was your job?

Yeah, they was working down there and there. Where was Joe playing then? Joe was playing in Lincoln Garden. Lincoln Garden. Louis was working at the Dreamland, and joined the band at the Dreamland. I mean Lil was working there together. So I come to Chicago and I joined Joe's band. Well Joe had George Fields and he had a big band. He had the kind of band that he had now. He had a corner player playing with a man by the name of Bob Schaffner. He went later to the plantation with Dave Payton. So with the band…
So I said, when did y'all go home?
